absent_reason.ci: The held registry reports a confidence interval for the MMRM least-squares mean difference, not for the served observed-case raw change-score mean difference. No matching raw mean-difference confidence interval is stated in either held source.

served_mismatch: The served arm means and sample sizes match registry outcome 0. However, the packet labels dispersion only as 'spread', so the served SD interpretation cannot be independently bound. The reported adjusted MMRM effect and its CI cannot be used as the observed-case raw MD and CI.

candidate_rejections.span: Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -3.6 (95% CI -7.20 to 0.07) | p =0.059 | METHOD Mixed Model for Repeated Measures
candidate_rejections.why: This is an adjusted MMRM contrast, not the served observed-case raw change-score MD; its CI cannot be attached to the raw arm means.

candidate_rejections.span: Least Square (LS) Mean Difference -3.6 (95% CI -7.16 to -0.03) | p =0.052 | METHOD ANCOVA
candidate_rejections.why: This belongs to the separate ANCOVA outcome using LOCF, not the served observed-case endpoint.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled elderly participants with treatment-resistant depression, within the question's adult population; eligibility specifies age 65 years or older.
entry_population_matches_question.span: A Randomized, Double-blind, Multicenter, Active-controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Intranasal Esketamine Plus an Oral Antidepressant in Elderly Subjects With Treatment-resistant Depression

notes: Registry spans were used; no full text or substantive abstract is held. Raw arm summaries are reported under the MMRM-labelled outcome, but 'observed-case' is not explicitly stated. Dispersion values retain the source's 'spread' label. No raw MD or CI was calculated. The extraction is set aside for the missing matching CI, not because the trial is ineligible.
